s.title: Max goes down
s.story: Procurement lowers DUMMY-001 Max Case/Day 20 → 16. The destinations have to fit first, so D/S changes the mapping before: JAPAN 12 → 6, KOREA 8 → 10 (total 16, still ≤ 20 when saved).
acts: Export Crossdock Master: DUMMY-001 JAPAN 12 → 6, KOREA 8 → 10
s.why: OPERATION_TYPE 1: AP POLE still has Max 20 until the KANBAN file. The Export rows go first (EXPORT_PRE), the down row (ROW_ORDER 1) before the up row (2), so the total never passes the Max that AP POLE has at that moment.

log: NSP check (RSARI): DUMMY-001 202612 total Case/Day 16 ≤ Max 20 → save allowed

SP_STG_WRITE('EXPORT', '202612', 'DUMMY-001', JAPAN **, 6)
  → E6 inserted, SYNC_STATUS 0; GTOPAS: no change for JAPAN
header: no unsent Kanban row of DUMMY-001 202612 → K4 OPERATION_TYPE 5 (Kanban unchanged, current values, not uploaded)

SP_STG_WRITE('EXPORT', '202612', 'DUMMY-001', KOREA **, 10)
  → E7 inserted, SYNC_STATUS 0; GTOPAS: no change for KOREA
NSP check (DANGGRAINI): DUMMY-001 202612 total Case/Day 16 ≤ Max 16 → save allowed

SP_STG_WRITE('KANBAN', '202612', 'DUMMY-001', Pcs 12, Max 16)
  → K4 updated (one unsent row per key): OPERATION_TYPE 1 (last sent Max 20 in 202612)
sync:
SP_STG_SYNC(SYNC_DT '2026-12-10 11:00:00', Current 202612, Next 202701, RSARI)
  → AP POLE rows with SYNC_STATUS 0 of 202612 and 202701 → 1 with SYNC_DT = time of the click; GTOPAS rows of 202612 → 1; LAST_SYNC_DATE_APPOLE
  → start the parent flow CDX_SYNC_PARENT (SYNC_DT 2026-12-10 11:00:00, RUN_TYPE SYNC)
Parent flow: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V_GTOPAS_CROSSDOCK WHERE SYNC_DT = '2026-12-10 11:00:00' → 0 → scenario 2: XD07 at once
XD07 AP POLE: read the views for the run
View, file of the Export rows per part (Kanban row with the same SYNC_DT, part and period):
DUMMY-001 202612: header K4, OPERATION_TYPE 1 → EXPORT_PRE (before KANBAN)
KANBAN file (OPERATION_TYPE 1 to 4): K4
XD07: EXPORT_PRE (2) → KANBAN (1) → SUCCESS. E-mail SUCCESS (one per run)
